items.title: SSAI
clues: I put the ad into the video before it reaches the viewer.
I run on the server, not on the device.
Ad blockers struggle to spot me because ads look like the show.
items.why: Server-side ad insertion stitches ads into the stream on the server.

items.title: Ad pod
clues: Each position in me can be sold separately.
items.why: An ad pod is the set of ads played in one break.

items.title: FAST channel
clues: I am free for the viewer.
My name starts with free ad-supported.
items.why: FAST channels are free, ad-supported and scheduled like TV.

items.title: Competitive separation
clues: I apply inside an ad break.
Rival brands should not appear together.
A car brand and its rival should not share a pod.
items.why: Competitive separation keeps rival advertisers away from each other in a break.
